title: VP of Product Management

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: As a manufacturer of large-format printing systems targeting outdoor signage, vehicle wraps, and architectural graphics, Durst's product leadership owns the complete value proposition delivered to their customers. This role is responsible for ensuring Durst's printers enable end-users to produce durable, long-lasting output that matches Durst's brand promise of 'performance, reliability, and longevity.' By integrating Tedlar as a recommended or certified overlaminate solution, Product Management can differentiate Durst's P5 series and other platforms with a proven 12-20+ year outdoor durability story, directly addressing customer pain points around UV degradation, fading, and premature failure. This role cares deeply about competitive positioning in the premium segment, customer success metrics, warranty claim reduction, and creating ecosystem partnerships that enhance Durst's total solution value. With recent launches like the P5 X and P5 SMP, they're actively seeking ways to strengthen their outdoor application story and protect their reputation for quality—making Tedlar a strategic product ecosystem opportunity that drives differentiation, reduces support costs, and enables premium pricing.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: This VP owns Durst's entire product portfolio strategy, including the recently launched P5 X flatbed and P5 SMP hybrid systems. They are responsible for competitive differentiation, product roadmap decisions, ecosystem partnerships, and ensuring Durst's equipment delivers on the company's brand promise of durability and reliability. They likely report to a Chief Product Officer or CEO and manage product managers, technical product marketing, and applications engineering teams. This role has direct authority over which consumables, substrates, and protective films are certified, recommended, or co-marketed with Durst printers—making them a gatekeeper for strategic supplier partnerships.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: For Durst's large-format printing customers producing outdoor signage, billboards, vehicle wraps, and architectural graphics, Tedlar provides the protective overlaminate that completes the durability story. Specifically: (1) Outdoor signage manufacturers using Durst P5 series printers can offer clients graphics that maintain color vibrancy and structural integrity for 12-20+ years without yellowing, cracking, or fading—reducing replacement cycles and warranty claims. (2) Vehicle wrap installers can protect high-value fleet graphics from UV damage, spray paint vandalism, and environmental exposure, creating a premium service tier. (3) Architectural graphics producers can spec Tedlar for building facades and transit interiors where graffiti resistance and extreme weather tolerance are critical. By certifying Tedlar as a recommended solution for Durst equipment, the VP can position Durst printers as the platform of choice for applications requiring maximum durability.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This VP is measured on product differentiation in a competitive market, customer satisfaction scores tied to output quality, reduction in warranty claims or support escalations related to premature print degradation, and the ability to command premium pricing for Durst equipment. They also own the success of recent product launches like the P5 X and P5 SMP—ensuring these platforms gain market traction and customer adoption. Tedlar addresses their pain points directly: it reduces downstream customer complaints about UV damage and fading (which reflect poorly on Durst's equipment), enables Durst to offer a complete 'durability ecosystem' story that competitors can't match, and creates a partnership opportunity that adds recurring revenue through certified consumables recommendations. Additionally, with Durst's emphasis on outdoor applications where substrate protection is critical, this VP needs solutions that protect their brand reputation for reliability and help customers achieve the long-term performance Durst promises.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Durst exhibited as a Platinum sponsor at PRINTING United Expo 2025 (February 3-5, Las Vegas) and received eleven 2025 PRINTING United Alliance Pinnacle Awards, indicating strong market momentum. They launched the P5 X flatbed printer in late 2024 and are actively promoting their outdoor application capabilities. Additionally, Durst exhibited at ISA Expo 2024 and Labelexpo 2025, showing sustained engagement with the signage and graphics community. This is an ideal time to reach out post-trade show season when they're evaluating partnerships to strengthen their product ecosystem for outdoor applications and differentiate newly launched platforms in the market.
